name: app-two-onboarding-screens-orbiting-avatars-and-notification-prompt
title: Orbiting Avatars and Notification Prompt
whatItIs: Two white phones on a pale blue swirl background: an 'Inspired people' screen with rounded portrait tiles orbiting a centre portrait and a black Cool! button, and a lock-screen screen with notification cards, floating memoji and a black 'Turn on notifications' button.
whatItMeans: Orbiting avatars make a number feel social, and the floating memoji bring the notification prompt to life.
techniques: Portraits arranged on a ring around a central one
Floating memoji circles above the prompt
Pink gradient lock screen inside the phone
Large black pill buttons as the single action
Notification cards overlapping the mock lock screen

vocabulary.definition: Items arranged in a ring around a centre.
A screen asking the user to allow a feature like notifications.
